description: This file declares a set of utility functions for reading from and writing to file descriptors, including functions for reading exact amounts of data, binary data, and socket communication. It interacts with a 'SharedFD' class and provides abstractions for reliable I/O operations on file descriptors.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads from a SharedFD until it is closed or errors, storing data in the provided string.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads exactly the number of bytes equal to buf->size() from a SharedFD, or until an error occurs.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads exactly 'size' bytes into a vector of chars from a SharedFD.

methods.name: ssize_t ReadExactBinary(SharedFD fd,T * binary_data)
methods.description: Template function that reads sizeof(T) bytes into a binary data structure from a SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all bytes from a std::string_view to a SharedFD, ensuring all data is written.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all bytes from a vector of characters to a SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes 'size' bytes from a buffer to a SharedFD.

methods.name: ssize_t WriteAllBinary(SharedFD fd,const T * binary_data)
methods.description: Template function that writes sizeof(T) bytes of binary data to a SharedFD.

methods.name: SendAll
methods.description: Sends a message through a socket, checking for socket errors.

methods.name: RecvAll
methods.description: Receives a specified number of bytes from a socket, returning the data or an empty string if an error occurs.
